title: EventFlagged
description: Records a human raising the human_flagged Flag on an existing Event after the fact. Never modifies the original Event (ADR-0001) — this is its own new record, referencing the original by id, with no field that could target or overwrite the original's own fields.

original_event_id.description: The id of the QueryAnswered Event this flags.

note.description: Optional human-written reason for the flag.
